title: FASTENAL CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Fastenal Company (FAST) filed a Form 8-K reporting results from its April 23, 2026 annual shareholder meeting. All 11 director nominees were elected, PricewaterhouseCoopers was ratified as the independent auditor for fiscal year 2026, executive compensation was approved on an advisory basis, and two equity compensation plans (Employee RSU Plan and Non-Employee Director Stock Plan) were approved. A shareholder proposal requesting EEO-1 report disclosure policy was rejected with 203.9 million votes for versus 680.8 million against.
key_points: Fastenal held annual meeting on April 23, 2026 with 1,055,737,147 of 1,148,328,513 shares outstanding represented (quorum present)
All 11 director nominees elected with varying support levels (votes against ranged from ~2.3 million to ~75.2 million)
Shareholders ratified appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 (1,053.4M for, 1.2M against)
Advisory vote to approve executive compensation passed with 831.8M for versus 102.5M against
Fastenal Company Employee Restricted Stock Unit Plan approved (904.6M for)
Fastenal Company Non-Employee Director Stock and Restricted Stock Unit Plan approved (919.7M for)
Shareholder proposal on EEO-1 report disclosure policy rejected (203.9M for, 680.8M against, 119.4M broker non-votes)
